dct_title_s: Map showing distribution of new building construction from March 13th 1923 to April 8th 1924
dct_alternative_sm: Map showing distribution of new building construction from March 13th 1923 to April 8th 1924
dct_description_sm: Map in sepia tone ink shows newly constructed buildings represented by black ink symbols for single family homes, duplex homes, four flat buildings, apartment buildings, stores, and industries. Pencil markings amend these symbols and add symbols for stores with residences above and churches.; Scale not given.; Marked in pencil: "1580/012."; Inscribed in pencil on verso: "New building population dot (old)."
